design_lock.plan_rule: L-shaped guest wings face a landscaped parking-and-pool courtyard
design_lock.entry_rule: a brick-and-glass lobby resolves the inside corner beneath a cedar-lined porte-cochere
design_lock.opening_rule: every room receives a physical recessed door and paired low-E window with modeled occupied depth

research.title: Skyview Motel Landscape
research.lesson: Treat the courtyard as a sequence of outdoor rooms tied to guest-room use, pool deck, planting, and the building rather than as leftover parking.

research.title: Modern Hotel and Bar
research.lesson: Machined metal rail, deliberate lighting, warm timber screens, and an occupied courtyard can transform the long exterior-corridor datum without erasing the motel typology.

research.title: The Isla
research.lesson: Repeat colour at entry openings, distinguish circulation surfaces, and use porous edge elements to make room access legible while breaking down an overlong facade.

research.title: Stairs at Zollenspieker Hotel
research.lesson: Exterior stair credibility depends on continuous structural stringers, box treads, supported landings, connected walkways, precise posts and integrated lighting.

sources.prompt_summary: Photoreal L-shaped two-storey prairie motor inn with exterior gallery, integrated stairs, glazed lobby, porte-cochere, pool court and deep-eaved hip roofs.
High oblique view locking the L plan, coherent hip-roof valleys, courtyard, pool, parking, rear service lane and two gallery-connected stairs.
Straight-on elevation fixing the repeated guest-room bay, gallery, roof, stair and lobby datums.
Close construction view of plate stringers, open pan treads, base plates, continuous landing, guardrails, gallery slab and support columns.
Inside-corner brick-and-glass lobby with modeled occupied depth, real vestibule, cedar soffit and structurally supported arrival canopy.
Quiet operational rear elevation with deeply inset windows, ventilation, condensers, meters, service door, refuse screen, drainage and downspouts.
Two-bay close-up locking thermally broken frames, low-E panes, screens, curtains, occupied room depth, recessed doors, hardware and gallery attachments.
Orthographic 3x3 plate of ivory stucco, russet brick, charcoal shingles, cedar, kelp-green metal, black steel, low-E glass, concrete and pool water.
